Hearth Engine and its editor: MIT; see LICENSE.
Three.js, Zod, meshoptimizer, gl-matrix, Victor Mono npm release 1.4.0:
MIT; their full notices are in licenses/.
Three.js also contains adapted shader/algorithm code with additional notices:
- Real-Time Collision Detection: required source credit in licenses/rtcd.txt.
- Minimal AgX: MIT, licenses/minimal-agx.txt.
- LTC / ACES fit: permissive terms and paper citation, licenses/ltc.txt.
- Filament and Khronos shader adaptations: Apache-2.0,
  licenses/apache-2.0.txt and licenses/shader-sources.txt.
Keep these license files with this distribution. Standalone editor/game HTML
and HTML exported by the editor include the same applicable notices.
The project MIT license does not replace third-party terms.
Font provenance and checksums: src/assets/fonts/SOURCE.txt.
Build/test dependencies retain their licenses; package-lock.json pins versions.
node_modules and build-tool executables are not included in the source archive.
Demo geometry is procedural. The supplied project describes its four terrain
textures as ImageGen-generated; that historical provenance is not independently
established by the files alone. Imported user content retains its own rights.
